description: Skredfaresoner i Tinn is a dataset listed in National Single Information Point of Norway, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Tinn kommune. Supplerende skredfaresoner registrert av NGU frem til 2015 før NVE overtok. Coverage: Tinn kommune. The publisher named on the listing is Tinn kommune. Its keywords include Det offentlige kartgrunnlaget, modellbaserteVegprosjekter, fellesDatakatalog, Samfunnssikkerhet, Local, Tinn kommune. The listing shows 1 download or service links in ZIP. The listing shows 2017-03-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://inspire.ec.europa.eu/metadata-codelist/ConditionsApplyingToAccessAndUse/noConditionsApply). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-nsip-no.
